integrity: Analytic proof and a standalone rational-arithmetic checker are included. Unlocated equivalent results remain a publication-priority risk.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-probe Rademacher XDiag versus four-probe BKS squared Euclidean risks for 2x2 SPD matrices; high-dimensional results assert existence of opposite risk advantages only. This is an exact-arithmetic comparison of conceptual estimators, not software reliability, general-budget performance or a finite-precision certificate.
title: A sharp planar risk crossover for exchangeable diagonal sketching
